title: Ill Gotten Gold... Vegetables II
description: Ill Gotten Gold... Vegetables II — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_A

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 20 Golded Pumpkins and 45 Golded Ears o' Corn from the golded farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: QuestGiver_A

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Collect 20 Golded Pumpkins and 45 Golded Ears o' Corn from the golded farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

We are prepared to ramp up our efforts to decode the mystery of the golded farms but to do it we need more of the golded vegetables. I know it seems like we are just sending you off to stand in a golded vegetable line, but this is of the utmost importance!

Head to the farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and collect the golded veggies needed to continue our research on how to reverse the golding process. When you have the required golded vegetables return to me, Yakov Smearnov, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

That is quite a grocery bag full of golded veggies! You have been invaluable to us, Dungeon Runner, and we thank you. Now that you are all buttered up, can I interest you in doing this quest again?

Objectives:

  • Golded Pumpkins ×20
  • Golded Ears o' Corn ×45

Client level range: 92–100
